Finding and learning the Colle Antidote in 4 hours

div.p: "We're a charity, we're a non-profit, so we're not trying to impress sponsors or investors or venture capitalists." — Our Director of Operations, Theo Wait, joined Greg Mustreader to discuss the online chess landscape, how we run Lichess behind the scenes, and much more! Watch the full episode on YouTube.

We've been collecting research publications using Lichess and just crossed 300 entries, with almost 100 from this year alone! We regularly publish data on our open database. Open source and open data are key for research, pushing the boundaries of human knowledge. Thank you to all the researchers!

The group stage of the Total Chess Pilot 2026 has started! Follow all the games in our broadcasts until 2026-11-20, featuring GMs Magnus Carlsen, Fabiano Caruana, Nodirbek Abdusattorov, Wesley So, Rameshbabu Praggnanandhaa, Vincent Keymer, and more.
We invite you to join us for a Bullet Arena on 2026-11-09 at 20:00 UTC in memory of GM Daniel Naroditsky, known on Lichess as @RebeccaHarris. Today would have been Danya's 31st birthday.

Our Game of the Month October Contest is underway: Share your best Lichess standard game played in October 2026 until 2026-11-12 at 00:00 UTC! The winner will be announced on 2026-11-24, followed by a blog post with commentary on the game.

Congratulations to team K2N_chess by FM Konstantin Kostin for winning our Streamer Arena November 2026! Congrats also to CSCA Open Events for taking 2nd place, to TIM NASIONAL CATUR ONLINE INDONESIA for 3rd place, and to Online World Chess Lovers for 4th place. Thanks to all participating streamers and 1,389 registered players!

We will be undergoing scheduled maintenance on 2026-11-07 at 07:00 UTC for (hopefully) under 30 minutes! We'll keep you updated on our social media channels, but in the meantime we hope you enjoy whatever activity you choose to fill the void.
